question: What is the new daily limit for checking bank balances through a single UPI app as per the National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI) rules effective 1 August 2025?
solution:
The correct answer is __**50 times**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **National Payments Corporation of India (NPCI)** has introduced a new regulatory framework to manage the frequency of non-financial transactions on the **UPI** platform.
 
• Effective from **1 August 2025**, a daily limit has been set for checking bank balances through a single **UPI** application.
 
• According to the new rules, a user is allowed to perform a maximum of **50 times** bank balance enquiries per day through one **UPI** app.
 
• The primary objective of this move is to reduce the excessive load on the **Core Banking Systems (CBS)** of member banks, which often face congestion due to frequent balance checks.
 
• By capping these non-financial requests, the **NPCI** aims to prioritize actual financial transactions and improve the overall success rate of payments by minimizing **Technical Declines (TD)**.
